24.
(1) The Council may in writing and subject to such
conditions  as  may  be  specified  therein,  delegate  to  the
Chairperson or any officer of the Council any of its powers,
duties  or  functions  and  any  such  officer  shall  exercise  or
perform such power or function in the name and on behalf,
(2)  The  Council  may,  notwithstanding  any  delegation
made  under  subsection  (1),  by  itself  exercise,  perform  or
discharge any power, duty or function so delegated and may
at any time revoke any such delegation.
